summary: Khoá học và repository Python toàn diện hướng dẫn xây dựng AI từ con số, bao gồm LLMs, agents, computer vision và reinforcement learning.
usecases: Rapid prototyping of LLM-powered autonomous agents for task automation.
Educational resource for mastering end-to-end AI pipeline development with Python.
Foundation for research experiments in swarm intelligence and multi-agent systems.
ideas: Deploy a multi-agent system on edge devices using Rust for performance-critical components.
Build a generative AI coding assistant that integrates with VS Code extensions.
Create a benchmark suite comparing different LLM agent architectures on real-world tasks.
